title: Enterprise VOIP / Softphone Endpoint Support & Troubleshooting
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Fix the call-quality and softphone issues that land on desktop support
problem: When a call drops, echoes, or the headset won't work, it lands on desktop support — who own the endpoint, not the phone system. This toolkit gives you a root-cause method and scripts for the endpoint side of enterprise VOIP/softphone: audio-device selection, headset/driver issues, network/QoS conditions, and client health — so technicians resolve the call-quality tickets they can actually control and escalate the rest with evidence.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the softphone/VOIP endpoint stack (audio device → client → network/QoS → service), what the endpoint owns vs the telephony platform, and the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need (endpoint access, audio-device inventory, network/QoS visibility, softphone client details) with how to verify each.
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (no/one-way audio, echo/robotic, wrong default device, headset not recognized, jitter/latency, client crash) with the exact endpoint-side checks per branch.
5 PowerShell scripts — audio-device + client discovery, per-device audio/network validation, a VOIP-readiness/quality report, safe remediation of device/driver issues, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (correct device, client healthy, network within thresholds), plus Best Practices for evidence-based escalation to the telephony team.
short: A root-cause method and scripts for the endpoint side of enterprise VOIP/softphone — audio devices, headsets/drivers, network/QoS, and client health — so support fixes what it controls and escalates the rest with evidence. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
